summary: hetzner.hcloud deprecates the hcloud_datacenter_info[].server_types return value after 1 October 2026; use hcloud_server_type_info[].locations[].available.
questions: How do I find which server types are available in an hcloud location?

answer_card.title: hcloud datacenter_info server_types deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `hcloud_datacenter_info[].server_types` is deprecated and will be removed after **1 October 2026**. Use `hcloud_server_type_info[].locations[].available` instead.
